Ai does the job here. It serves its purpose. Fills a void, as stated in many of the comments…However, my heart aches for all the classical musicians. Keep in mind, so many musicians have given years and decades of love, dedication, and sacrifice to their craft. They accrued university debt, travel time, paid high cost of living in big cities like NYC - resulting in less hiring for soundtracks and gigs of excellence due to digital/Ai productions.
